project_type: Full-stack rugby video analysis web application with Python backend (FastAPI), React frontend, and computer vision pipeline (YOLO/ByteTrack)
build_system: uv for Python dependency management, npm/vite for frontend, Docker Compose for full-stack orchestration
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for backend, vitest for frontend, pytest-security for OWASP checks
build_command: cd backend && uv sync && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
test_command: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v && cd ../frontend && npm run test
verification_instructions: 1. Run backend tests: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v. 2. Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build. 3. Run docker-compose build to validate containers. 4. Run security tests: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/security/ -v
setup_instructions: 1. pyenv local 3.11.15. 2. cd backend && uv sync. 3. cd frontend && npm install. 4. Copy .env.example to .env and configure API keys.
environment_constraints: Sandbox has no GPU - tests must mock CV inference. Target deployment hardware: GTX 1060 8GB VRAM, 32GB RAM. Network is OPEN_INTERNET - all packages installable. Python 3.11 available via pyenv. Required: dnf install mesa-libGL for OpenCV.
contribution_requirements: SOLID principles mandatory. ISO 42010 architecture documentation. Security tests for API/socket endpoints. OWASP compliance. BDD/TDD approach.
key_patterns: Hexagonal architecture (ports & adapters) for AI provider abstraction. Strategy pattern for tracking modes. Observer pattern for real-time events via WebSocket. Repository pattern for data access. Factory pattern for AI provider instantiation.
directory_structure: Monorepo: /backend (FastAPI + CV pipeline), /frontend (React + Vite), /docs (ISO 42010 architecture docs), /docker (Dockerfiles), /.github (CI), root has docker-compose.yml
